- Schema expects numbers (decimal with comma in source). Will convert to numeric using dot as decimal separator in final JSON (e.g., 418.19) unless schema accepts local format—final output will use numbers with decimal point.

7. No inference beyond visible data
- Do not invent other fields; any missing fields would be empty (but all required fields are found).
